title: Ikuyo Kita
statementMd:
Ikuyo Kita, better known as ¡Ya llegué, vámonos!, was declared Protectora de la Soberanía after the CIA captured Maduro.

In her first decree, Kita designed a system to provide internet access to everyone. She can place up to two base stations and coverage is provided within a circular radius around each central. Kita wants to minimize the sum of these two radii while ensuring that every person is covered by at least one central.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/589eed02c4788efa83235f4508108a6e8053e6a2.png)

## Input

The first line of the input will contain one integer, $n$ $(1 \leq n \leq 50)$, where $n$ represents the number of points.

The following $n$ lines will each contain two integers $x_i$ and $y_i$ $( x_i, y_i \leq |10^6|)$, representing the coordinates of a point.

No two points will have identical coordinates.

## Output

Print one number representing the answer to the problem. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{-6}$.
statementZhMd:
喜多郁代，更广为人知的名字是 ¡Ya llegué, vámonos!，在 CIA 抓捕马杜罗后被宣布为主权守护者。

在她颁布的第一项法令中，喜多设计了一套为所有人提供互联网接入的系统。她最多可以设置两个基站，每个基站的覆盖范围都是以其为圆心、以相应覆盖半径画出的圆形区域。喜多希望在确保每个人都至少被一个基站覆盖的前提下，最小化这两个半径之和。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/589eed02c4788efa83235f4508108a6e8053e6a2.png)

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $n$ $(1 \leq n \leq 50)$，其中 $n$ 表示点的数量。

接下来的 $n$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $x_i$ 和 $y_i$ $( x_i, y_i \leq |10^6|)$，表示一个点的坐标。

任意两个点的坐标均不相同。

## 输出格式

输出一个数，表示本题的答案。如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{-6}$，则会被判定为正确。
